title: ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to approving the recommended list of Business Source Center (BSC) operators pursuant to the results…
text:
[Council File 21-0270]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to approving the recommended list of Business Source Center (BSC) operators pursuant to the results of the reissued 2026 Los Angeles BusinessSource Center (LABSC) Request for Proposals, authorize execution of contracts with BSC operators and centralized service providers, and approve the LABSC replacement operator list.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, Community Investment Department (CID), or designee, to negotiate and execute contracts with the recommended:
a. Operators as outlined in Table 1 of the CID report dated October 29, 2026, attached to the Council file, for the operation of ten (10) Los Angeles Business Source Centers (LABSC) System for the period of January 1, 2027 through June 30, 2027, with an option for the City of Los Angeles to renew for up to three (3) additional, one-year terms, subject to funding availability and the approval by the City Attorney as to form.
b. Contractors as outlined in Table 2 of the CID report dated October 29, 2026, attached to the Council file, to provide centralized services to the LABSC System, for the period of January 1, 2027 through June 30, 2027, with an option for the City of Los Angeles to renew for up to three (3) additional one- year terms, subject to funding availability and the approval by the City Attorney as to form.
2. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, CID, or designee, to:
a. Establish a Replacement Operator List for the LABSC and Centralized Services System as outlined in Table 4 of the CID report dated October 29, 2026, attached to the Council file. In the event a selected operator or service provider is unable to continue providing services to the LABSC System, AUTHORIZE the General Manager, CID, or a designee, to select a new operator or service provider using the replacement operator list.
b. Prepare Controller instructions and any necessary technical adjustments consistent with the Mayor and Council action, subject to approval of the City Administrative Officer (CAO), and AUTHORIZE the Controller to implement the instructions.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CID reports that there is no impact to the General Fund. The LABSC System is funded through the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program. Funding was approved by the City Council in the Program Year 52 Consolidated Plan.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
